page.title: Pump Setup
page.subtitle: Create pump locations, configure nozzles, set prices, manage staff and credit clients.
page.noPumps: No pump is set up for your account yet. Ask the platform administrator to add one.

sections.managerNote: You can update daily fuel prices below. Other pump settings are managed by your Owner or Admin.

tankers.summary: Configure tanker sizes and set the default

settings.invalidAmount: Enter a valid positive amount, or leave blank to disable escalation.
settings.explanation: When a shift closes with a discrepancy above this amount, only Owner or Admin can resolve it. Managers will see it as locked. Leave blank to disable escalation.
settings.effectOn: Shortages or overages above {{amount}} will need Owner or Admin to resolve.
settings.effectOff: Blank: managers can resolve every discrepancy.

gst.prefixFormat: Invoice prefix must be 1 to 5 letters or digits.
gst.businessHint: Needed before you can issue tax invoices to credit clients.
gst.gstinHelp: 15 characters, as on your GST certificate.
gst.numberingHint: Every invoice number starts with this prefix, and the count restarts every April.

prices.enterOne: Enter at least one price to save.
prices.needDu: Add at least one DU with a nozzle first (Dispensers & nozzles step).
prices.staleHint: . Enter new prices below, or confirm they are unchanged.
prices.stillNeededPrice: A new price for at least one fuel

deviation.title: Large price change
deviation.body: Are you sure you want to set this price? This is a significant deviation from the last recorded price.

tanks.intro: Add each underground tank manually. Multiple tanks per fuel type are allowed. Set capacity so that stock level bars and low-stock alerts work correctly.
tanks.dipToleranceHint: How far a dip reading may differ from book stock before it is flagged.
tanks.dipToleranceHelp: Dip checks within ±{{amount}} of book stock count as matching.

nozzles.intro: Each Dispensary Unit (DU) is a physical MPD machine. Add one or more nozzles to each DU — each nozzle carries exactly one fuel type with its own meter counter. CNG nozzles cannot share a DU with other fuel types.

disable.title: Disable nozzle #{{number}}
disable.subtitle: Take this nozzle offline for maintenance or operational issues.
disable.warning: No new shifts can be opened on this nozzle until it is re-enabled. Close any active shift first.

limit.increaseHint: If you have added a new machine, you can increase the limit below.

mapTank.title: Map nozzle to tank
mapTank.subtitle: Assign nozzle #{{number}} ({{fuel}}) to the tank it draws from.

dip.mapFirst: Map this nozzle to a tank before recording drained fuel.
dip.title: Record fuel dip
dip.subtitle: Record fuel physically removed from the tank, such as maintenance draining or contamination removal. The litres leave the tank's stock and the loss is valued at their purchase cost.
dip.notMapped: This nozzle is not mapped to a tank, so drained fuel cannot be recorded yet.
dip.todayOnly: Recorded for today — drained fuel leaves today's stock, so it cannot be back-dated.

reading.title: Adjust meter reading
reading.subtitle: Use this only when the meter was replaced, reset, or the stored reading is wrong.
reading.activeShiftWarning: Cannot be done while an active shift is running on this nozzle.
reading.customHint: Enter a replacement reading for this nozzle.
reading.resetHint: Apply a full zero reset to this nozzle's meter.
reading.resetWarningBefore: This will reset the meter on nozzle #{{number}} to
reading.resetWarningAfter: . This action is logged and cannot be undone.
reading.reasonHint: This note is stored with the adjustment log for audit history.

createDu.nozzleRequired: Add at least one nozzle with a fuel type.
createDu.title: Add a new Dispensary Unit
createDu.subtitle: A Dispensary Unit (DU) is a physical MPD machine. Give it a name and add one or more nozzles — each nozzle carries exactly one fuel type.
createDu.name: DU name
createDu.stillNeededNozzle: A nozzle with a fuel type
createDu.nozzlesHint: Each nozzle has a unique number and exactly one fuel type.

staff.nightShiftConsentHint: If left unchecked, shift planning will skip night-shift assignment for this operator.

menu.editHint: Update name, phone number, or role
menu.resetPasswordHint: Set a temporary password they must change at next sign-in
menu.preferencesHint: Set preferred shift and weekly day off
menu.leaveHint: Add or remove leave dates for this staff member
menu.payRatesHint: Configure hourly or daily pay rates
menu.moveHint: Assign this staff member to another of your pumps
menu.activateHint: Allow this staff member to work again
menu.deactivateHint: Temporarily remove this staff member from active use

add.title: Add staff member
add.subtitle: They sign in with this phone number and temporary password.
add.passwordHint: They choose their own password at first sign-in.

move.title: Move {{name}} to another of your pumps
move.explanation: They are signed out and see the new pump at their next sign-in. Not allowed while they have an open shift or an unresolved discrepancy.
move.noOtherPump: You have no other active pump to move them to.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.consequence: {{name}} is signed out and can't sign in until you activate them again. Not allowed while they have an open shift or an unresolved discrepancy.

preferences.title: Shift preferences for {{name}}
preferences.loadFailed: Could not load saved preferences. Close and try again.

rates.hourlyHint: Shift 1 (12 AM–8 AM) = night rate · Shift 2 & 3 (8 AM–12 AM) = standard rate
rates.dailyHint: Paid per working day · leave days are deducted automatically

empty.title: No staff yet
empty.body: Add the people who run your shifts. They sign in with their phone number.

tankers.intro: Configure the tanker trucks used to deliver fuel. When recording a delivery, the total quantity across all tanks must exactly match the selected tanker's capacity.
tankers.capacityMin: Capacity must be at least 100 L.
tankers.name: Tanker name

shiftDefs.empty: No shift definitions yet. Add your first schedule below.
shiftDefs.deleteConsequence: Only a schedule that no shift has used yet can be deleted. This can't be undone.
shiftDefs.disableExplanation: Operators can't open new shifts on it after the last active date.
shiftDefs.activeUntilHint: The schedule will remain active until this date.

form.endRequired: Enter an end date, or untick "Set end date"
form.endAfterStart: End date must be after the start date
form.nameRequired: Each shift must have a name
form.endsBeforeStart: "{{name}}" ends before it starts. Only the Night shift can cross midnight. Did you select AM instead of PM?
form.endsBeforeStartShort: Ends before it starts. Tick Night if it runs past midnight.
form.title: New shift schedule
form.overlapHint: Any previously open schedule will be automatically closed on the day before the start date. You cannot create two schedules with overlapping date ranges.

timeline.label: 24-hour timeline. {{shifts}}
timeline.fullDay: Covers all 24 hours with no overlaps

credit.body: Customers who buy fuel on credit are added on the Credit page. Skip this step if you do not sell on credit.

steps.stillToDo_one: {{count}} required step is still to do
steps.stillToDo_other: {{count}} required steps are still to do
